name: tree
title: Tree
description: A nested list of items that open and close, with one selected item.
a11y: role=tree with treeitem children and role=group for branches; aria-expanded on branches, aria-selected on every item, aria-level on each.
Roving tabindex: one item is in the tab order; Tab enters and leaves the tree as one stop.
ArrowUp/ArrowDown move, ArrowRight opens a branch then enters it, ArrowLeft closes it then goes to the parent, Home and End jump.
Enter or Space selects; typing letters jumps to the next label that starts with them. The tree needs an aria-label.

props.name: items
props.description: The top-level nodes; each node has an `id`, a `label` and optional `children`.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected node id. Controlled with `value` + `onValueChange`, or uncontrolled with `defaultValue`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The id of the node selected at first when uncontrolled. Default none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the id of the node the user selects.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Open branches. Controlled with `expanded` + `onExpandedChange`, or uncontrolled with `defaultExpanded`.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Ids of the branches open at first when uncontrolled. Default none.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with the full list of open branch ids when the user opens or closes a branch.
